highlight.text: His works displayed a wide tonal range, and his brushwork was brought to the fore due to the large scale of the hanging scrolls on which he often painted.

source.label: Wikipedia: he “most frequently painted myna birds, lotuses, and rocks”
Wikipedia: “Bada used ink and brush on paper to render his paintings”

work.text: He mostly painted on small album leaves in his early years and later preferred large hanging scrolls.
A genuine work of the divine category

moment.text: In the 20th century, copies of Bada Shanren's art were made and studied by Chinese artists such as Qi Baishi, Wu Changshi, and Zhang Daqian.

matters.text: He sat cross-legged among the lotus leaves.
